dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.admin.title: Set up your first widget
dashboard.admin.description: Four steps take you from an empty inbox to live chats on your site.
dashboard.admin.steps.category.title: Add a category
dashboard.admin.steps.category.descripti: Categories decide which agents receive a chat, for example Sales or Support.
dashboard.admin.steps.widget.title: Design your widget
dashboard.admin.steps.widget.description: Pick the colors, greeting messages and topics visitors can choose from.
dashboard.admin.steps.agents.title: Invite your agents
dashboard.admin.steps.agents.description: Agents only see the chats that are assigned to them.
dashboard.admin.steps.embed.title: Put it on your site
dashboard.admin.steps.embed.description: Copy one script tag into the pages where visitors need help.
dashboard.queue.title: Live queue
dashboard.queue.empty_hint: New chat requests will line up here.
dashboard.team.title: Team
dashboard.agent.title: Waiting for chats
dashboard.agent.description: Chat requests for your categories will show up here.
dashboard.agent.availability_note: Presence is not connected yet. This switch only previews the control.
auth.login.title: Log in to your account
auth.login.description: Enter your email and password below to log in
auth.login.portal_description: Use the email and password of your Auth Portal account.
auth.login.portal_hint: Admin and agent access is managed in the portal. If you cannot get in, ask a portal administrator.
auth.no_chat_access.title: No chat access
auth.no_chat_access.body: Your credentials are correct, but this account is not an admin or an agent here. Ask an administrator to give you access.
auth.portal.no_access_hint: Access follows your Auth Portal roles, so ask a portal administrator to add you.
auth.portal.unreachable.title: Auth Portal unreachable
auth.portal.unreachable.body: We could not reach the Auth Portal just now, so your sign-in could not be checked. Your password was not rejected. Wait a moment and try again, and tell an administrator if it keeps happening.
setup.brand.subtitle: Installation
setup.stepper.label: Setup progress
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to :app
setup.welcome.description: A few quick steps and your support chat is ready. First we check that this server can run it.
setup.token.title: Confirm setup access
setup.token.description: Enter the one-time setup token so nobody else can claim this server.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.token.hint: It is printed once in the application log at startup (with Docker: docker compose logs app) and set as SETUP_TOKEN.
setup.env.title: Environment check
setup.env.locked: The environment check appears once the token is verified.
setup.env.all_ok: Everything this server needs is in place.
setup.env.one_failed: One check needs attention before you can continue.
setup.env.some_failed: :count checks need attention before you can continue.
setup.mode.title: How will people sign in?
setup.mode.description: This choice is locked once setup finishes.
setup.mode.fortify.title: Starter kit auth
setup.mode.fortify.description: Accounts live in this app. Email and password with two-factor and passkeys. Admins manage agents here.
setup.mode.pizzasys.title: Auth Portal (pizzasys)
setup.mode.pizzasys.description: People sign in through your organization's Auth Portal. Admin and agent access comes from the portal's roles.
setup.admin.title: Create the first admin
setup.admin.description: This account manages widgets, agents and settings.
setup.admin.name: Full name
setup.admin.password_hint: Choose a long, unique password. It is hashed before it is saved.
setup.basics.title: App basics
setup.basics.description: You can change all of this later in Settings.
setup.basics.app_name_hint: Shown in the dashboard and in emails.
setup.basics.app_url_hint: The address people use to reach this app, including https://.
setup.basics.idle_timeout_hint: Chats close automatically after :minutes minutes without messages. Default: 120.
setup.basics.idle_timeout_range: Use a whole number from :min to :max.
setup.run.title: Install
setup.run.description: Review the details, then start. Every step can be repeated safely.
setup.run.summary.title: What will be set up
setup.run.error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
setup.run.error.forbidden: The setup token is not verified for this session. Reload the page and verify it again.
setup.run.error.conflict: Another setup run is in progress. Wait a moment, then retry.
setup.run.error.session_expired: Your session expired. Reload the page, then retry.
setup.run.error.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
setup.run.error.invalid_response: The server sent an unexpected answer.
setup.done.title: You're all set
setup.done.description: Setup is complete. Sign in to open your dashboard.
setup.pizzasys.title: Connect your Auth Portal
setup.pizzasys.description: Tell this app where the Auth Portal lives and which service credential to use. Test each connection before you continue.
setup.pizzasys.done_description: Setup is complete. Sign in with your Auth Portal account to open your dashboard.
setup.pizzasys.env.production_descriptio: The portal your team signs in with every day.
setup.pizzasys.env.testing_description: A second portal for trying changes safely. Leave it empty if you do not have one; you can add it later in Settings.
setup.pizzasys.label: Display name
setup.pizzasys.label_hint: Only used on this page. Optional.
setup.pizzasys.base_url_hint: The web address of the portal, for example https://auth.example.com. Plain http only works for localhost and .test hosts.
setup.pizzasys.service_name_hint: The name this app is registered under in the portal. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
setup.pizzasys.service_token_hint: From the service client you created for this app in the portal. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
setup.pizzasys.token_keep_hint: Leave this empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
setup.pizzasys.nats_description: With NATS the portal tells this app the moment someone's access changes. Without it everything still works; changes just arrive a little later.
setup.pizzasys.verify_tls_hint: Keep this on. Turn it off only for a test portal with a self-signed certificate.
setup.pizzasys.verify_tls_off_warning: Certificate checks are off. Anyone on the network path could impersonate the portal.
setup.pizzasys.roles.title: Who gets in
setup.pizzasys.roles.description: Which people are admins or agents is decided in the portal. Here you only say which permission names count.
setup.pizzasys.roles.admin_permission_hi: Anyone who has this permission in the portal is an administrator here.
setup.pizzasys.roles.agent_permission_hi: Anyone who has this permission can take chats.
setup.pizzasys.roles.super_roles_hint: Portal roles that always mean administrator, even without the permission above. Press Enter after each name.
setup.pizzasys.active.title: Active environment
setup.pizzasys.active.description: Everyone signs in against the active environment. You can switch later in Settings.
setup.pizzasys.active.testing_hint: Use the testing portal. Available once Testing is filled in.
setup.pizzasys.test.save_note: Your entries are saved first, then checked. The service token is stored encrypted.
setup.pizzasys.test.summary.passed: The connection works. Every check passed.
setup.pizzasys.test.summary.warning: Connected, with a warning. The app will work.
setup.pizzasys.test.summary.failed: The connection does not work yet. Fix what failed below, then test again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.network: Could not reach this server. Check your connection and try again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.forbidden: You are not allowed to run this check. Reload the page and verify the setup token again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.session_expire: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.not_found: This environment is not saved yet. Fill it in and try again.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.validation: The server could not test this environment.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.server: The server reported an error while testing.
setup.pizzasys.test_error.invalid_respon: The server sent an unexpected answer.
setup.pizzasys.hint.reachable: Check the portal address, DNS and firewall. For a test portal with a self-signed certificate you can turn off certificate verification.
setup.pizzasys.hint.service_credential: The portal rejected this app's service credential. Create or rotate the service client in the portal, then paste the new token here.
setup.pizzasys.hint.latency: The portal answered slowly. Sign-ins still work, but check the network between the two servers.
setup.pizzasys.hint.nats: NATS is optional. Check the NATS address and token, or clear them to run without instant sign-out.
setup.pizzasys.error.url: Enter a full web address such as https://auth.example.com.
setup.pizzasys.error.https: Use https. Plain http is only accepted for localhost and .test hosts.
setup.pizzasys.error.service_name: Use up to 64 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
setup.pizzasys.error.token_required: Paste the service token for this environment.
setup.pizzasys.error.nats_url: A NATS address cannot contain spaces.
setup.pizzasys.error.same_permission: The agent permission must differ from the admin permission, or every agent would be an admin.
setup.pizzasys.error.role_name: A role name can be at most 100 characters.
setup.pizzasys.error.active_unconfigured: Fill in the Testing environment first, or keep Production active.
setup.pizzasys.portal.title: Sign in as a portal admin
setup.pizzasys.portal.description: Prove the connection end to end with an Auth Portal account that has the :permission permission (or a super role). That account becomes this app's first administrator, and setup cannot finish without it.
setup.pizzasys.portal.privacy: The password is only used for this check and is not saved. The portal's sign-in token is discarded.
setup.pizzasys.portal.verified_body: This account signed in through the portal and has admin access, so you cannot lock yourself out.
setup.pizzasys.portal.problem.invalid.ti: The portal did not accept those details
setup.pizzasys.portal.problem.invalid.bo: Check the email and password for this environment and try again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.problem.unavailabl: The portal could not complete the sign-in
It may be unreachable, or it may have rejected this app's service credential. Go back and run Test connection to see which, then try again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.problem.no_chat_ac: This account signed in, but it has neither the admin nor the agent permission here. Give it :permission in the portal, or use another account.
This account is not an administrator
It can use chat as an agent, but the first account must be an admin. Use an account that has :permission or one of your super roles.
setup.pizzasys.portal.problem.unknown.bo: The portal check did not pass. Try again, or go back and test the connection.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.title: Could not verify the sign-in
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.network: Could not reach this server. Check your connection and try again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Reload the page and verify the setup token again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.session_expi: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.not_found: This step is no longer available. Reload the page.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.validation: Enter the portal email and password.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.server: The server reported an error. Try again in a moment.
setup.pizzasys.portal.error.invalid_resp: The server sent an unexpected answer.
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.name: Name
settings.profile.managed.description: Your name and email address, as your Auth Portal account has them.
settings.profile.managed.title: Managed in the Auth Portal
settings.profile.managed.body: Your name, email address and password belong to your Auth Portal account, so they cannot be changed here.
settings.auth.title: Authentication
settings.auth.description_portal: How people sign in through your Auth Portal, and how its permissions map onto this app.
settings.auth.description_local: How people sign in to this app.
settings.auth.forbidden.title: Administrators only
settings.auth.forbidden.body: Only administrators can see or change how sign-in works.
settings.auth.managed.title: Managed by this app
settings.auth.managed.description: Accounts live in this app, so there is no Auth Portal to configure.
settings.auth.managed.accounts: Admins add and manage agents here, in the app.
settings.auth.managed.security: Passwords, two-factor authentication and passkeys are handled in each person's Security settings.
settings.auth.managed.locked: The sign-in method is chosen once, during setup, and cannot be changed afterwards.
settings.auth.health.title: Portal health
settings.auth.health.description: Whether sign-ins can reach the portal right now.
settings.auth.health.credential_rejected: The Auth Portal rejected this app's service credentials. New sign-ins are blocked until you save a valid service token for the active environment (people who are signed in keep working for a grace period).
settings.auth.health.status_hint.ok: The portal answers and accepts this app's service credential.
settings.auth.health.status_hint.degrade: The portal is failing some requests, or rejecting this app's service credential. People who are signed in keep working for a grace period; new sign-ins may fail.
settings.auth.health.status_hint.down: The portal is not answering. People who are signed in keep working for a grace period; new sign-ins fail.
settings.auth.health.status_hint.unknown: Nothing has been checked yet. This updates on the next sign-in or connection test.
settings.auth.health.circuit_closed: Closed: requests go to the portal normally.
settings.auth.health.circuit_open: Open: after repeated failures, requests to the portal are paused for a short time.
settings.auth.health.nats_state.unknown: Enabled, no signal from the consumer yet
settings.auth.env.active_note: This environment is live: changes apply to sign-ins right away. Test the connection after saving.
settings.auth.env.dirty_hint: Save your changes to test them. The test checks what is saved.
settings.auth.switch.title: Active environment
settings.auth.switch.description: Everyone signs in against the active environment. Switching signs everyone out.
settings.auth.switch.unavailable: Set up the other environment first: its address, service name and token.
settings.auth.switch.dialog.title: Switch to :environment?
settings.auth.switch.dialog.description: Sign-ins will go through :host from now on.
settings.auth.switch.dialog.consequence_: Everyone is signed out, including you. You sign in again on :environment.
The live-update connection (NATS) restarts against the new environment.
The change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.auth.switch.dialog.credentials: To make sure nobody gets locked out, sign in as an administrator on :environment. The switch is refused if that sign-in does not work.
settings.auth.switch.dialog.email: Admin email on the new environment
settings.auth.switch.dialog.acknowledge: I understand that everyone, including me, will be signed out.
settings.auth.switch.dialog.checking: Checking the sign-in on the new environment...
settings.auth.switch.dialog.success: Switched. Taking you to sign in...
settings.auth.switch.error.rejected: The switch was refused. Check the email and password and try again.
settings.auth.switch.error.network: Could not reach this server. Check your connection and try again.
settings.auth.switch.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to switch environments.
settings.auth.switch.error.session_expir: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
settings.auth.switch.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
settings.auth.switch.error.not_found: This action is not available. Reload the page.
settings.auth.switch.error.validation: Enter the admin email and password.
settings.auth.switch.error.server: The server reported an error. Nothing was changed.
settings.auth.switch.error.invalid_respo: The server sent an unexpected answer. Reload the page to see which environment is active.
settings.auth.roles.note: Nobody is signed out. Everyone's access is re-checked on their next request, yours included, so keep at least one admin permission or super role that you hold.
